$comment: Volume targets for the generated demo brain. Derived 2026-07-30 from shape surveys of three real brains (numbers only — see README.md provenance). 'target' guides the generator (P2); 'min' is asserted by the layer-2 seed-integration tests — a seed run below a min is a FAILED run, which is exactly the v1 failure mode (37 nodes, silently).

survey.$comment: What the donors actually looked like, for calibration honesty. dev = documentation-heavy dev brain; client = production client brain (heavy assistant usage); personal = email-bearing personal brain.

note.notes: site-visit series, technical queries, minutes, personal notes

journal.notes: work + LATHE + TRAILRUN with mood; first-person

task.notes: ≥15 open at seed time, ≥5 due in the future window

page.notes: ≥10 in nested sub-trees; ≥3 procedure revision families (supersession)

file.notes: mix: pdf drawings/references, docx, xlsx budgets, png site/lathe photos

event.notes: recurring standups + runs; ≥6 AFTER seed time so the dashboard shows a future

contact.notes: exactly the world.json cast (16 incl. owner); the email allowlist

table.notes: ≥2 with formula columns, ≥2 with aggregates, 1 currency+select pipeline

secret.notes: obviously-fake values; proves the screen renders

branch.notes: RECALIBRATED 2026-07-30: branches are ltree roots the APP creates per content type, not something the seeder authors. The original 16 assumed seeded branches and could never be met; a real seed lands ~11.

emails.notes: threaded; every sender in the contact cast; PUMPHOUSE lead-time saga + STOREFRONT snag dispute + ISLAND data requests

derived.$comment: Produced by the real ingest pipeline (P3), never inserted directly. Mins prove ingest actually ran — the 'generator ran fine, produced zero facts' tripwire.

content_chunks.notes: RECALIBRATED 2026-07-30. The original 1500 applied the client donor's chunks-per-node ratio to THIS node count — but that donor is few-and-long (177 files, multi-page procedures) while this corpus is many-and-short (224 emails, 120 notes). The first full seed produced exactly 1.00 chunks/node: nothing was long enough to split. Fixed on BOTH sides — the long-form genres are now genuinely long (lib/longform.mjs), and the target reflects this corpus's composition rather than the donor's.

behavioural.$comment: Produced by REAL scripted turns and worker runs (P4), never hand-written rows.

traces.notes: donor avg 8-9 steps/trace; script turns that exercise search, delegation, table queries, page edits (rejected as read-only in serve mode, fine at seed time)

assistant_messages.notes: across ≥3 agents so Studio + per-agent threads look alive

runs.notes: mix of finished/failed so /runs shows texture

span_days.notes: offsets -180..+21; ~40% of dated artifacts in the last 30 days
